title: Informa's Wellness Acquisition Adds a B2B Event and a Nonprofit Question
summary: Informa is buying its way into the $6.8 trillion wellness economy with two respected but nonprofit-linked brands. The bigger story may not be the wellness bet itself, but what happens when a public events giant absorbs an organization built as a 501(c)(3) — a structural wrinkle the companies haven't yet explained.

title: A Sneak Peek at the Leaders Attending Skift Meetings Forum 2026
summary: The fastest read on any event is who else shows up. By that measure, Skift Meetings Forum 2026 is already one of the strongest rooms on the fall calendar.

title: The 50 New Hotels Meeting Planners Should Know About
summary: Planners have never had more new hotels to choose from, with the South leading the way in 2026 U.S. openings and future projects.

title: Meeting Planner Salaries: Why They Never Agree
summary: Stop comparing titles. Compare scope, budget, and impact to make sure you're getting paid what you're worth.

title: How Scotland’s Tartan Army Helped Win a 2028 Incentive Program
summary: Unscripted fan energy just outsold a polished pitch deck. It’s a reminder that a destination’s own people can sell it harder than any campaign.

title: Why Are Late Payments Getting Worse in the Meetings Industry?
summary: Suppliers have become zero-interest lenders to their own clients. It may be time for the industry to develop upfront-payment standards to deal with the problem.

title: Why Your Photography Waiver Doesn’t Cover Facial Recognition
summary: A checkbox that says "photography and videography" may be doing legal and ethical work it was never built for. As facial recognition, AI-enabled wearables and passive recording become more common at events, planners are facing a bigger question: What exactly have attendees consented to?

title: What Years of Job Postings Reveal About the Events Industry
summary: The METHOD Project, an initiative analyzing event industry jobs and salaries, confirms what planners have been sensing anecdotally: The title with staying power and a salary bump isn't planner, it's marketer.

title: Jamie Murdock Named FICP’s New President
